title: Nobody Should Be Paying An Agency For This Anymore
description:
Meta officially connected Facebook Ads to Claude. One connector, and Claude builds the full campaign structure: objective, ad set, targeting, placements and three ad copy variations, all left paused for you to review inside Facebook Ads Manager. It also checks your pixel and Conversions API setup, loads your product catalog, and tells you which ad sets to scale and which to kill.

Agencies charge 10 to 20 percent of ad spend, or $2,000 to $3,500 a month, to do exactly this. Now it runs from a chat window.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VYqv3QGWcAhumeJ6FPTLI8ZwNRfpb8ktAhUKDyU7rZ8/edit?usp=sharing
